reviews.text: Excellent veterinary clinic, welcoming, professional, and attentive.
Excellent veterinarian, I highly recommend him. The staff is welcoming and warm.
A fantastic team, thank you to the vets and assistants, a team that is caring both for our little animals and for the people. Don't change a thing!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!

A huge thank you to the entire team for taking in my little bunny, Peluche, as an emergency case and agreeing to operate on her so quickly. You cared for her with great professionalism, gentleness, and kindness. I was kept informed throughout her care and felt supported and listened to until the very end. Sadly, Peluche passed away after her operation, but I will always be deeply grateful to the whole team for everything you did for her and for your kindness during this incredibly difficult time.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
Very serious

The healthcare staff are excellent, very available, and highly trained.
The clinic's equipment is state-of-the-art.
Friendly welcome, competent, attentive.

An outrageously expensive consultation.

€133 for a 20-minute consultation on a Sunday.
I paid €56 for the consultation plus an emergency surcharge (7 PM - 8 AM) even though I arrived at 10:54 AM. Can you explain this?
Why is the surcharge (€77) more expensive than the main service, which is the consultation itself?
I only have one word in mind: robbery.
It's like having onions as an extra charge, which is more expensive than a hamburger.

There's no price list displayed.
I repeat, if you're desperate because your pet is bleeding from every orifice, go there; they'll bleed you dry too.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
I came in for an emergency, and the staff and the vet were fantastic!!

Worst veterinary clinic in the world! All they care about is money.

You bring your sick pet in, but they refuse to treat it because you don't have enough money to pay.

It's unacceptable to leave an animal suffering, but the only times they do accept it, they tell you it's not worth paying given your situation and that they did the bare minimum to keep it alive for one night.

A year later, you receive a letter from a bailiff harassing you to pay this debt. It's a shame I didn't record the vet and the receptionist on the phone telling me I wasn't obligated to pay because they did the bare minimum. I made them repeat it five times before bringing my cat in, though.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!

This woman is Dr. Yvinec, the vet who saved my cat! I will be forever grateful to her. Professional, direct, empathetic, and also humane. An incredible vet!!!

Our experience at this clinic lasted a few months. It wasn't perfect: disappointing attitude from some of the receptionists, very high prices, and a vet we saw in the emergency room who was beyond anything we could have imagined. She told me that my daughter's kitten might not make it through the night, but refused to let her give it a last cuddle just in case. My daughter was devastated, and this same woman was demanding over €1,000 upfront to start a transfusion and kept refusing to let us say goodbye to our beloved cat. I found her truly ungrateful, and I was shocked by her methods.

So yes, the overall experience wasn't perfect, far from it, but the fact remains that my cat survived thanks to a team of veterinarians and assistants who truly did their best, and especially thanks to Dr. Yvinec. Thank you!

A bunch of incompetents, except for Dr. Vassal, who was professional and efficient. The rest of the team lacks competence, and they know it perfectly well themselves, since every time we're told, "You have to see Dr. Vassal because he studied in Canada." That says it all.

We never see the same vet from one visit to the next, and each one says something different.

I dealt with two women, completely inhumane "vets." My cat was hospitalized for a week, and it wasn't until the second day, when I finally saw Dr. Vassal, that he was able to see where the problem was coming from and treat him.

A vet told me that I would have to "stop" my cat, who is only 8 years old and very active. Luckily, we didn't listen to that crazy woman's advice, because after a course of antibiotics, everything is fine.

The customer service is just as bad: the women on the phone are unpleasant and disrespectful. If you wait so long to get through to someone, it's because they're chatting amongst themselves instead of answering your calls.

And all this for exorbitant prices, with no professionalism or consistent follow-up.

Avoid this place.

Hello/Good evening, I am very disappointed with their service. On Sunday, August 23, 2026, I dropped off my cat, who was on the verge of death. Shortly after, I was informed of his passing that day. I was asked to pay the bill before they would take care of my cat for cremation. The bill isn't the problem; the worst part is that I received no information about how it would all work. I was told he would leave on Wednesday, but when did he actually leave for cremation on August 28? He was cremated on September 4, and today is September 14, and I still haven't heard anything about when I can get him back. From 1 to 2 weeks, it's now been over 15 days, and I didn't even know I'd be able to attend the cremation, considering I paid over €500. I had to add another €90 when I called to get a proper urn with his paw prints. Luckily I called, otherwise it would have come back to me in a disposable urn just for scattering the ashes. Lack of information and excessively long delays, terrible service. I've been waiting for three weeks without knowing what they're doing with my cat. It's already hard enough, but this is incomprehensible.
Money before the emergency

Called for an emergency regarding my cat... very good telephone reception.
Once there, the reception and care were just as excellent.
Thank you.

Avoid at all costs! Never take your dog there. For years, many have testified to the incompetence of this veterinary clinic; only money matters to them. Avoid it completely, and expect a bill of over €2000 once they take your dog away.

Here are the facts:
I dropped off my dog ​​at 9:00 AM for a dental cleaning that required anesthesia. I asked what time I should pick her up. I was told to come at 5:30 PM.

I arrived at 5:20 PM, went to reception, and explained the reason for my visit: "to pick up my dog ​​after her dental cleaning." They told me that was noted and to please wait.

At 5:50 PM, I still hadn't heard anything about my dog, even though I had seen people who arrived after me being called in and then leaving for 30 minutes! So I went to inquire at reception, and the person called the vet, who told me he was on his way.

At 6:05 PM, fifteen minutes after my initial inquiry, I went back to reception to tell them I had waited long enough and asked them to come and get my dog. I was told that it was the vet I saw that morning who was supposed to give her back to me, and I was told that it was fortunate that it was organized that way. So, to sum up, their brilliant organization makes clients wait for 45 minutes to get their pet back—brilliant organization indeed!

Finally, seeing my anger, a (nice) vet who overheard the conversation left and returned three minutes later with my dog. I have nothing against the vets or the reception staff, only the completely idiotic organization. Basically, if the vet you see in the morning is running two hours late for whatever reason, then you're stuck waiting for two hours in the evening!

INHUMANE AND SHAMEFUL!

I first came to the clinic two or three years ago for an emergency appointment with my rabbit. She was dying, and I wanted to end her suffering. Imagine my shock when I had to wait two hours in the waiting room with my pet, who was writhing in agony. When the on-call vet finally saw us, she told me the rabbit was fine. My rabbit couldn't even stand up anymore and was losing fur in clumps. I had to insist. After several attempts at an IV drip, she came back and told me that my rabbit was indeed in very bad shape, so dehydrated that she couldn't find a vein. Therefore, we had to end her suffering by injecting fluid directly into her heart.

I'm not leaving a review at this point because my dogs and cats are treated there, and in the meantime, I've been seen by excellent vets.

Today, my new rabbit is having a sudden stoppage in her digestive system. She's not moving, eating, or drinking, she's completely lethargic... in short, it's an EMERGENCY! So I went to them because when we searched online for "exotic pets vet," the results came up. Besides, the other vets were too far away, and I was very worried she wouldn't survive the trip. I was greeted with a big smile and then refused to see my pet because, and I quote, "The vet working today doesn't treat exotic pets and she's fully booked. Go to Grand Littoral." I explained to the receptionist that my rabbit is very weak and wouldn't survive the journey. Then the vet, Dr. Théa Bareille, arrived with a big smile: "No, I don't treat exotic pets, there's nothing we can do, go to Grand Littoral." So I replied, "Great, so if she dies on the way, that's just wonderful." She replied with a big smile, "Thank you, goodbye, and good luck."

Not for a single second did they look at my rabbit's condition, not once did they try to help me or find a solution.

It's shameful. I had to take my rabbit, who arrived at Grand Littoral in a catastrophic state in 30-degree heat, to the vet clinic.

There are some good vets, and this review doesn't apply to them, but the majority are incompetent and inhumane.

If I could give zero stars, believe me, I would.
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!

All the veterinarians are highly competent, attentive, and very gentle with our animals. A big thank you to Dr. Bareille, who took excellent care of Nouchka, as well as to Dr. Roumillac. The entire reception staff were incredibly kind. This veterinary clinic is highly recommended.

Incredible veterinary hospital! They managed to save our cat, who was truly on the verge of death.

We are eternally grateful. Special mention to veterinarian Mélanie Moret, who was so gentle and affectionate with our beloved little cat.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

Completely incompetent and a thief
I've never seen anything like it
My 1-year-old cat has a lump on his neck and a fever (41°C).
He's hyperventilating.
So I go there.
He's been seen for 2 hours (he could have died 12 times over).
When I'm seen, the so-called vet tells me, "Listen, I'm not knowledgeable about respiratory issues, I'll go see my colleague" (maybe he got his degree from a Kinder Surprise?).
Then they tell me that to find out what the lump is, I need a CT scan costing €700.
I can't afford it, so I refuse.
I at least ask for a blood test to see if it's infectious.
He refuses, telling me, "A blood test is only used to check if the organs are okay." Well, yes and no.
And that's it.
No treatment for the fever (no anti-inflammatories).
They do give me antibiotics, though.
So, in the end... I paid €70 for antibiotics.
I've never seen anything like it in my life.
They could have even given the antibiotics intravenously since I was there, they had the equipment, and that would have justified the €55 charge for a procedure that didn't even exist, but no.
Anyway, I advise you to find something else, really.

On August 23rd, I took my cat to the emergency vet. A first vet saw me for initial examinations. She then kept her in the hospital. The next day, I called for an update. I was told that her condition was more serious than initially thought, but that a difficult procedure could be performed. That same evening, I arrived at the clinic to see my little cat. A second vet saw me, and then came the unexpected twist: I learned that this vet refused to operate on my cat, even though I had clearly stated several times that I wanted the surgery and was willing to risk everything to save her. I repeatedly asked about the cost of the procedure. She never answered, instead calling in the so-called surgeon who also refused to perform the operation. Frankly, she was an unfriendly person, cold and devoid of any empathy or sensitivity towards me. Once again, I asked about the cost of the procedure. He told me he didn't know exactly, around 4,000 or 5,000 euros. In short, a complete rip-off to avoid treating my cat. I should point out that no one could definitively tell me the exact cause of the illness, and they all refused, once again, a biopsy that was perfectly feasible. All they wanted was to put my poor little thing down without doing anything but gloating. I strongly advise against this clinic. It's a complete mess, and I was shocked to see the state of the room; it wasn't cleaned, there was fur everywhere, and bloodstains on the floor. When they brought my cat in, they had force-fed her and hadn't even cleaned her; she was in a disgusting state. Gone are the days when veterinarians got their hands dirty to do their job. On top of that, they made me pay upfront for three nights of hospitalization. She only stayed one night in the end, and we still paid full price, not even a discount for the nights she didn't stay. An exorbitant price for a half-hearted service, and a lot of heartache on top of that. The vets at this clinic disgust me. For a week now, I've been thinking about my poor cat who might have been saved by someone competent. Years ago, Dr. Pinto worked a miracle on one of my cats. It's a shame all vets aren't like that...

Excellent veterinary clinic.
Staff are attentive to your pet's needs.
Dr. Pinto is excellent; he tried to save my dog ​​for years. Sadly, my dog ​​passed away, but I would like to thank him because he did everything he could to save him. Idefix

Immediate assistance provided.
Excellent staff.

We lost our little Looping on August 20, 2025. After noticing his increasing fatigue, and not understanding why, I decided to take him to our vet. Unfortunately, he was on vacation. So, I was referred to the Massilia Veterinary Hospital.

I was somewhat familiar with them, having had a kitten I found in the street examined there a few months earlier.

The team quickly took charge of our little cat, who was suffering from severe jaundice. Sadly, our 10-year-old sweetheart's condition deteriorated rapidly for various reasons, and he passed away.

The team was extraordinary. We received calls every morning with comprehensive reports. We visited him every evening for a week, and each time we were received with genuine kindness. Looping was monitored daily; numerous tests and procedures were performed, and they did everything they could to save him.

Even on that fateful day when our little Looping decided to leave us, they showed extraordinary empathy. They brought our little darling to us on a cart in a private, enclosed room, laid him there under a blanket, cleaned him, and gave us the time we needed to say goodbye. Even in death, he was magnificent. We loved him so much.

Even though we are overwhelmed with grief, we know that the entire team demonstrated exemplary professionalism.

A special thank you to Dr. Wucher for his daily care and to his two colleagues, Dr. Thomas and Dr. Roumilhac, who all three cared for our little one every day. Thank you also to all the other members of the team without exception.

The facility is clean, the animals are well cared for, the care is provided daily, their equipment is top-notch, they offer payment plans, and above all, they are incredibly empathetic and professional.

Thank you again for everything. We would have preferred to end your services with better news, but we couldn't help but thank you and commend you for your support during this difficult time. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
Excellent hospital, warm and welcoming staff, I highly recommend it 🙂

Thank you for everything you did for my beautiful girl 🙏. After a month and a half without any news of my kitty, she came home very thin, and you immediately told me I should bring her in without worrying me at all. You kept her, and she came home in much better shape with a new diet and medication. I can't thank you enough for calling me 3, 4, or 5 times a day to give me updates.

I'm giving 1 star because I can't give 0.
Absolutely no consideration for the animal. They mistreated my dog, who was suffering from a pneumothorax. She was admitted at 8 a.m. and went into cardiac arrest that afternoon without receiving any treatment.
They handed my dog ​​over to a cart with a flimsy blanket and said, "Here, figure it out yourselves, good luck."
If you don't have an appointment, you can easily wait 1 to 1.5 hours.

Three appointments with three different vets for an epileptic seizure. The first was wonderful, but the last one, "Eleanor," for end-of-life care, showed absolutely no empathy! She barely placed him on the table, his hindquarters still dangling, before sedating him. Luckily, we caught him from falling! She didn't even give us a chance to say a proper goodbye before rushing us to pay, leaving his body alone on the corner of the table. It was a traumatic experience, leaving no room for proper grieving after 12 years together.

I usually come to this veterinary clinic and everything usually goes well; the staff is attentive.

This time, I went there on a Sunday as an emergency because my cat had a huge abscess on his cheek from being bitten. They had to drain the abscess and give him antibiotics.
So far, so good.

However, when I picked up my cat, he was in a terrible state. They hadn't even bothered to clean the pus and blood around his fur. They barely shaved around it, even though I knew it would continue to ooze and I would have cleaned it again at home.

For the price we pay, I would have expected to get my cat back in decent condition, not covered in blood and pus. At the very least, they should have washed him and cleaned up the dried blood.

Veterinary clinic or money-making machine?? €2500 (pelvic surgery and 4 days of hospitalization due to a car accident) to give me back a soiled dog who hadn't eaten for 5 days, an undiagnosed dislocated shoulder, and severe gingivitis that makes it difficult for her to eat.
In short, it's a disgrace to take advantage of people's distress so easily!
Exorbitant price, and certainly not commensurate with the quality and service provided. Karma will get you!!!

IRRESPONSIBLE PRACTICES AND EXORBITANT CHARGES!
Absolutely avoid this place! If I could, I'd give it zero stars.

I brought my kitten in as an emergency in a very weak state. The vet ran a series of expensive tests, constantly changing the diagnosis: feline panleukopenia, kidney infection, intestinal problem, then a urinary tract infection 24 hours later… A string of contradictions solely designed to inflate the bill (€500 in total) and play on our emotions.
They kept him overnight just to rehydrate and feed him, then wanted to extend his stay for several days for antibiotics—something they should have done from the start! I had to negotiate hard to stop the ordeal and get my kitten back, who left in worse condition than when he arrived.
Highly competent veterinarians

I highly recommend this clinic and especially Dr. Fournet, who operated on my dog ​​Phibie for a very difficult-to-access cervical hernia. He is an excellent surgeon who explains the procedure very well. My dog ​​is no longer suffering; she is thriving. Thank you to the entire team.

A terrible experience!
My cat had stopped eating and defecating. He had no energy and had lost weight. My partner, on the advice of a vet in Sakakini, took my cat in one Monday morning.

He called me and said it would cost 300 euros for an emergency consultation, blood work, and an ultrasound. I said yes, as my cat was unwell and I was extremely worried.
He called me back shortly after and said, "Well, he has a liver problem, he's very dehydrated, and they say he needs to be kept for 48 hours for observation at a cost of 900 euros..." I'll let you do the math on how much they're asking for, not even a diagnosis... So I called my sister, who has pets, and she told me to take my cat and leave. They only care about money, not animal welfare. My partner then told them no to hospitalization, and they offered him one less night, so 800 euros instead of 900. What a joke! He said no, and then they asked him, "But do you want the medication?"

"Well, yes, otherwise why come?" They didn't even explain how to administer it. Anyway... Two days later, on my sister's advice, I took my cat to the vet in St. Just.
And for 100 euros, they cured my cat! For 100 euros, I got:
a proper appointment with a thorough examination and excellent communication to understand his condition. They didn't even mention money! No, they were trying to understand his condition!

And it turns out he wasn't dehydrated! They explained everything to me! Why his liver was affected due to rapid weight loss and a lack of appetite, etc. They explained everything and gave the cat the medication and a cream to stimulate his appetite, plus they sold us a bag of kibble and a pipette to administer the medication...
Two days later, everything was back to normal!

I will never come back to your place and I strongly advise against going there if you love your pet.

I've been taking every pet I've had there for over 10 years now. I go for the quality of their specialized surgical care, and everything goes very smoothly every time, whether it's minor dental surgery for a rabbit or a dog or more complex procedures like spaying or neutering.

The follow-up care is regular, and every veterinarian I've seen has always been passionate, offered excellent advice, and been very attentive to our questions.

Special mention goes to Dr. THEVENOT at Massilia (St. Julien) and Dr. LERDINO (in Aubagne), who were incredibly dedicated to my rabbit's care. Dr. LERDINO demonstrated exceptional energy and instilled remarkable trust (for both the animal and the owner). We were able to ask her all the questions we wanted—she's truly passionate!

Thank you again,
Vincent
Attentive staff, I have my three cats there
Factory...
Dr. Lopez is fantastic! I have complete confidence in him! The staff is friendly and attentive. We feel safe with our little pets.

We came in as an emergency last night.
We were greeted by a kind and reassuring veterinarian.

Thank you again.

I was seen by Dr. Laurine Ollagnier when I came to pick up my cat after his surgery. Her explanations were clear, and she took the time to answer all my questions.

Very professional and truly kind.
Thank you again!

Profit is all they care about.
They talk to you about quotes with your pet half-dead on the table. And then there's the added insult of, "When you take on an animal, you have to be prepared to take responsibility for it." Absolutely no compassion.
Some of the receptionists are haughty. In short, there are more humane, more accommodating, and certainly more customer-focused veterinarians than Massilia. Avoid them at all costs.

First of all, thank you to the entire team, and secondly, thank you to Ms. Maud Pic for her kindness and compassion. She was always there for me when my companion Jack passed away, and for that, I thank her from the bottom of my heart.

Excellent veterinarian, don't change a thing, you're the best. Thank you a thousand times.

I highly recommend Massilia, and if you have a problem with one veterinarian, don't condemn the entire practice, because I was delighted with my experience with Maud Pic.

I took my cat to the emergency clinic around 10 pm for respiratory distress. He was seen very quickly, the staff were welcoming, caring, and responsive, and the facilities were clean and pleasant. After the examination, it turned out to be more of a scare than anything else. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. Thank you very much.

I called on a public holiday for an emergency; my cat was badly injured. They confirmed an appointment by phone for 2:30 PM. When we arrived, they refused to honor the appointment, explaining that they didn't take appointments. Why then had they given us one in the first place?! They briefly examined my cat and told us to come back tomorrow if we didn't want to wait all day.
The first and only place I will now take my pet. Not that the other vets in Marseille are bad, but here the team works really well, the equipment is comprehensive, and they do excellent work.
Perfect
My dog ​​was severely anemic; she received a transfusion, an IV drip, and was hospitalized for two days. She was saved thanks to the vet's quick response, and the follow-up care has been excellent.
Good in every respect
Alright

Excellent veterinary clinic.
I highly recommend it. Ruby, Shadow, and Misty are treated here, and we are very happy with them.

Our experience at Clinique Massalia was very disappointing.

At 3:00 a.m., we called the clinic to explain the very worrying condition of our dog, Rio (difficulty breathing, significant weakness). We were advised to wait until morning and consult our usual veterinarian.

At 6:00 a.m., his condition having worsened, we rushed him to the clinic. An X-ray showed an enlarged heart, but we were advised to take him home, as hospitalization would be an additional source of stress.

As soon as we got home, his condition suddenly worsened: breathing at nearly 70 breaths per minute, repeated fainting spells, and a blue tongue. We returned to the clinic immediately. Another veterinarian offered to hospitalize him until Monday, with no possibility of seeing a cardiologist before then, but no specific treatment or oxygen therapy was offered despite the seriousness of his condition. He was only prescribed medication for his throat.

We finally left the clinic completely distraught. Our dog was still struggling to breathe and was repeatedly losing consciousness.

Fortunately, another clinic immediately diagnosed acute heart failure with pulmonary edema, administered oxygen, and initiated appropriate treatment that stabilized his condition.

Looking back, we can't help but think that the precious time lost that day may have diminished his chances and that faster intervention could have prevented his condition from worsening.

We understand that emergency work is difficult, but animals cannot explain what they are feeling. They are entirely dependent on the assessment and responsiveness of the professionals who care for them.

We share this story with great sadness, hoping that other animals can benefit from faster care in similar situations.

THANK YOU!! Excellent vet, quick service. Last night, my Pekingese was limping on his hind leg; the diagnosis was patellar instability, an anti-inflammatory injection, and rest for my old boy.
People complain about the prices, I can understand, but saving our animals is priceless. Besides, 5 years ago I took my 17-year-old dog there, and we were overjoyed to see her.
The clinic refused to let me pay anything, so this place is far from being the money-making machine some people describe.
Very satisfied, especially with our veterinarian Dr. Wucher, who is very professional.

A veritable factory...but real specialists who can solve many problems with our animals...it's a shame the "human" aspect is neglected.

...
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
Top-notch veterinary center, not too long a wait, very pleasant doctor, large and beautiful veterinary center, and great for nighttime emergencies. Thank you to them! 👏 …

I've been taking my dog ​​to this establishment for 10 years.
I'm delighted.

Excellent clinic, very welcoming and highly competent staff despite the very late hour. My dog ​​received excellent care.
I highly recommend it.

We brought our dog in last night for a consultation. He had an ear infection, which we were aware of, but he was very downcast after paying €220 only to be told, "You'll probably have to bring him back to your vet tomorrow morning because, apart from an ear infection, I can't tell you anything else." It turns out our dog has a salivary gland infection due to the ear infection. I find that very unreasonable. So, last night, they put a cream in each ear and gave him an injection for digestion—I don't see the connection, but anyway… I find it outrageously expensive, excuse me, not to know what my dog ​​might have and to miss a salivary gland infection even though he was examined.
I've been calling for 21 minutes and there's been no answer!
Avoid at all costs!!! Money-grabbing scam

Thank you to Dr. Girault for his professionalism and for taking such good care of Chipie, despite the 3-hour wait in the air conditioning which gave me a nasty case of bronchitis 😉😤... but the main thing is that Chipie is doing well now. Thank you. …

1 because we can't give 0. This clinic does not dispense medication, even with a prescription, unless the animal has had a consultation at the clinic itself. If you are coming to Marseille on vacation, there is no treatment available for your pet at this clinic!!!

Thank you for reading this post carefully, fellow dog owners. Let me introduce myself: I'm 41 years old and a mother of three dogs. Sometime between Sunday night and Monday morning, my 5-year-old Staffordshire Bull Terrier started having diarrhea. I start work at 6:30 am, as I'm a healthcare professional. Before leaving, she started having loose, bloody stools. I knew something was wrong, so I told my partner I was going to work and would be back at 8:00 am. I'd take her to our vet because he starts later, and at least she wouldn't be alone.

I hadn't even arrived at work before he called me, saying the dog was defecating and there was more and more blood. So I turned around and went home. She was drooling and foaming at the mouth. By the time we got there, we'd rushed to the only vet in Massilia for an emergency appointment. Upon arrival, a very kind assistant greeted us, registered us, and noticed that the dog was bleeding from her rear end in a spurt. She told me we had to wait because they were busy. I should point out that when we arrived, there was no one in the waiting room. The dog started bleeding again, and she gave us a swabbing pad. I went to see if they could come quickly, and she told me that if we left, she would see because there were cameras in the waiting room. We were registered at 7:30 AM for 20 minutes, but no one was there, and the dog continued to bleed, with blood flowing from her rear end. Fear gripped us; we thought we were going to lose her. There was no one at reception except the cleaning lady. Some of the staff came in because the clinic opened at 8:00 AM. They walked past us, saw the blood-soaked pad, and barely said hello. There was no compassion, no concern. Okay, I'll take it upon myself. The morning assistant arrives, she's very attentive, and just by looking at her eyes she can see it's serious. I ask her, "At 8:00, please, it's been 30 minutes. Look at the dog, it's been dripping drop by drop now, and it's just blood." She tells me she'll call. Right in front of me, she calls and says nothing. 8:10, still no one. My partner tells me, "Let's go, our vet will open in 20 minutes." So we leave. I arrive at our clinic, where they confirm the problem. The vet sees us immediately. The dog is losing a lot of blood, is congested, and hypothermic. She keeps her and will keep us updated. It turns out it's poisoning. My dog ​​is better, rest assured, she's come home with us under observation. It's not over yet, but she's on the mend.

I am very angry with the clinic. It's an emergency service, and if no one could see her, they should have said so immediately. We would have left, and I would have looked elsewhere. The security cameras clearly showed the dog bleeding for 40 minutes, but no one came to see us. Why? What was the real emergency then? She should have stopped breathing.
I'm not from a generation that forgets on social media, but I'm not going to hold back. I know many dog ​​owners, and having volunteered at shelters and associations, I'm not going to hesitate to tell my story, since that's the only way things work these days. I absolutely do not recommend this clinic, and I am extremely disappointed by everyone who came in that morning. The clinic opened at 8:00 AM, and they all walked right past the dog with her drool and her blood-soaked pad, and not one, not one, asked us what was going on. I can't upload the photos to show you, but I'll put them on my social media to show you the seriousness of the situation.

This veterinary clinic is absolutely to be avoided. After a 6-hour wait and much insistence, my dog ​​was finally given an X-ray for a suspected urinary retention problem. The examination couldn't detect the issue, but the clinic performed it anyway and charged €300, refusing to share the results with my veterinarian or me. I saw many other animals in distress there who were poorly treated or not treated at all.
Avoid this place if you want to care for your pet.
Visited in June
A very reputable clinic, I go there with complete confidence!

Quick and efficient service.
Great :-)

Professional, a fantastic, dynamic, and understanding team, attentive to your needs, and with no price gouging. Easy payment options. Don't forget that we, as human beings, have social security and supplemental health insurance! Look at your health insurance statements and you'll see how much even the smallest procedure/ultrasound/X-ray costs.
Open 24/7, all year round!

The vets anesthetized him, performed an ultrasound, and discovered a tuft of hair stuck under his tongue. The tuft was removed immediately. Today, my puppy is doing very well and has regained all his energy. I am extremely grateful to this veterinary clinic, which listened, reacted quickly, and relieved his suffering.
